title: Limits and Verification
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Limits and Verification.
learning_objectives: Explain limits and verification using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for limits and verification
Assess failure and operational limits of limits and verification
concepts_covered: Unit tests cover the in-memory model and custom handler, not interoperability with an OpenTelemetry Collector.
OTLPHandler is a local custom handler; the store is memory-backed and main does not mount an official OTLP receiver/exporter.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
